The '''Jurio system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Companion" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jurio]].<ref name="Codex " /> Sometime between [[3681 BBY]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and [[3666 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}} {{TORcite|type=codex|Vectory Hyllus}} states that [[Vector Hyllus]] was 26, and the Codex entry is acquired during Act I, which means that Hyllus was born in [[3666 BBY]].</ref> the Jurio system was conquered by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of their [[Great Galactic War|invasion]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Jurio was eventually granted Imperial governance,<ref name="Codex" /> and the system remained under Imperial control for many years.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=codex|SIS Asset Brief: Agent Rane Kovach}}</ref>
